summary: Regression backend re-test after fix for POST /api/admin/products duplicate 'slug' kwarg TypeError. Ran full pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py). All 27/27 tests passed including TestAdmin::test_product_crud which exercises POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/products with admin JWT.
seed_data_creation: None; test_product_crud creates and cleans up its own product.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (27/27). Prior HIGH bug on create_product duplicate slug kwarg is resolved. Frontend was verified passing in iteration_1.
rca of the issue: Previously server.py:331 called Product(**body.model_dump(), slug=slug) while body.model_dump() already contained a 'slug' key (from ProductCreate schema), causing TypeError: multiple values for keyword argument 'slug'. Fix: build a dict, set data['slug'] explicitly, then Product(**data). Verified via TestAdmin::test_product_crud PASS.
